run_kappa_calculations: run thermal conductivity calculations on a set of atomic structures using KappaRunner
load_kappa_data: load atomic structures from an extxyz file using get_kappa103_data_list
write_kappa_results: write kappa calculation results to a gzipped JSON file using write_results
init_kappa_runner: initialize a KappaRunner with an ASE calculator and displacement parameter
check_imaginary_frequencies: check for imaginary phonon frequencies during force constant calculation in KappaRunner
